name: @hypaware/claude-desktop
description: Claude Desktop adapter for HypAware. Desktop delegates inference to its embedded CLI, so gateway usage lands under the claude client with entrypoint 'claude-desktop-3p' (LLP 0133#attribution). This plugin renders and places the org-managed third-party-inference profile as the managed-preferences plist (/Library/Managed Preferences/com.anthropic.claudefordesktop.plist), via an inline sudo prompt solo or an MDM push on a centrally managed deployment. Its picker row is hidden (LLP 0297): Claude Desktop is never offered during onboarding, and is set up only by explicitly running 'hyp client claude-desktop install'.

picker.name: claude-desktop
picker.label: Claude Desktop
picker.summary: Records Claude Desktop conversations and starts a local gateway listener. Needs Claude sign-in and admin approval; setup asks before changing anything.

commands.name: client claude-desktop profile
commands.summary: Render the managed 3P-inference profile for Claude Desktop

commands.name: client claude-desktop install-helper
commands.summary: Write the no-arg credential wrapper the Desktop profile points at

commands.name: client claude-desktop status
commands.summary: Show the resolved Desktop profile inputs (endpoint, mode, helper)

commands.name: client claude-desktop install
commands.summary: Configure Claude Desktop end to end: explain and confirm, login, helper write, residue clear, managed plist write, restart prompt

commands.name: client claude-desktop verify
commands.summary: Verify the Desktop plist install and print the in-app capture-check hint

config_sections.summary: Desktop profile inputs: { models?, endpoint?, helper_path?, bundle_id? }. Rendered values only; the profile never carries a secret.
